descriptionHtml:
Onikuma X91 RGB Gaming Headset with 50mm Drivers and Flexible High-Definition Microphone - White Edition

Elevate your dynamic audio aesthetics and achieve total focus during intensive gameplay with the stunning Onikuma X91 RGB Gaming Headset in Pure White. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium PC hardware audio peripheral is masterfully engineered for tactical esports players, passionate live streamers, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand crisp spatial soundscapes, clear team communication, and long-session comfort. Boasting an ultra-sleek white profile that flawlessly complements white mechanical setups, this headset delivers a perfect blend of high-fidelity sound and modern design.

The Onikuma X91 White is driven by massive high-grade 50mm speaker units optimized to project an immersive surround soundscape with rich bass response and sharp high frequencies. It features a fully flexible, high-definition (HD) omnidirectional microphone that incorporates built-in ambient noise reduction filters to capture your natural voice clearly while omitting distracting background clutter. For exceptional anti-fatigue endurance during long-hour runs, the over-ear cups are loaded with soft, breathable memory foam cushions, accented by brilliant dynamic RGB lighting channels running along its clean white frame.
